blocks.content: Four deterministic plain-Node suites use disposable test roots. Current review execution: skills.test.mjs 36 passed; plugins.test.mjs 21 passed (including real stdio MCP roundtrip); security.test.mjs 45 passed; doc-plugins.test.mjs 57 passed. Zero failures. These checks cover validation, persistence, approvals, path containment, backend URL policy, and generated document structure, not a complete security audit or native Windows/Linux acceptance. generate-doc-samples.mjs writes sample documents.
build:main, then all four suites; any failure exits non-zero. See open-source-readiness for the current execution receipt and limitations.
The path-containment suite caught resolveWithin rejecting targets spelled via a symlinked project root (e.g. /var vs /private/var) — fixed to accept both spellings while still refusing escapes.
